title: Charge magnitude at B
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must state the magnitude of the charge at B is q.

title: Polarity of all charges
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must correctly identify all three charges (A, B, C) as positive.

title: Charge magnitude at C
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (3) must give the charge at C as ((3 - sqrt(3))/3)q or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Field superposition at M
description: Important: The student must apply superposition at midpoint M, concluding the fields from A and B cancel, implying equal magnitude and opposite direction.

title: Geometry and distances
description: Important: The student must correctly use the equilateral triangle geometry to relate distances AN, BN, and CN (e.g., AN = sqrt(3) * BN = sqrt(3) * CN).

title: Field superposition at N
description: Important: The student must set up the correct vector superposition at point N, relating the vertical components from charges A, B, and C to satisfy the given upward direction.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns a negative sign to any charge polarity or misinterprets the field direction from a point charge.

title: Algebraic or simplification error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student makes an algebraic mistake when solving the equation from point N, leading to an incorrect expression for q_C.
